card.title: Must Be Nice
card.instruction: Treat another person’s ease with ordinary life as both inspiring and unfair. Copy their shortcuts while dismissing the advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Must be nice, cooking dinner in twenty minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I chop tomorrow's vegetables while tonight's dinner cooks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pass me tomorrow's carrots, then. Lovely having a whole spare evening inside this one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Take half home. Tomorrow you only have to tip them in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take the tub too. Apparently effortless people already have containers.
